status: Local email abstraction, templates and private Development/Staging capture implemented; real-provider staging delivery and bounce integration remain open gates.
scope: Windows isolated synthetic verification only. No real recipients contacted, no network transport, no production email, no customer/live database changes. Existing checkpoint worker remains metadata-only.

backend.database: Dedicated disposable MySQL schema; removed after tests.

validation.databaseMigrations: Unchanged; no new migration for offline capture.
validation.dependencies: No new or changed third-party dependency/lockfile.
validation.frontend: No changes; frontend/browser suites not rerun for this release.

implemented: Recipient-bound IEmailSender contract with closed result codes and private-safe string representations.
HTML/plain-text company invitation, task-assignment and workspace-welcome preview templates; strict addresses, trusted origin and closed routes.
Explicit offline worker command with bounded private input, safe JSON status, no database or HTTP pipeline dependency.
Atomic local directory capture, MIME integrity validation, restart deduplication, conflict refusal and per-company OS locking/hourly limits.
Default-disabled mode, Development synthetic addresses, Staging exact allowlists/HTTPS, Production refusal.
Published-process synthetic verification added to CI; only safe status/count evidence uploaded.
acceptanceGates: Hosted CI/CodeQL, Linux/container and selected-host ACL/local-filesystem checks not executed here.
No SMTP/provider adapter, API credentials, actual staging-recipient delivery or authenticated bounce/webhook integration.
No durable recipient-bound database email queue or automatic business-event-to-mail conversion.
Future workflow must recheck current recipient/company/project authorization, tokens, preferences, expiry and abuse controls.
Capture limits and deduplication are per local filesystem, not cross-host provider quota/fairness or power-loss durability guarantees.
next: SaaS-019 account verification, recovery/change and reauthentication; real mail delivery acceptance remains required before SaaS-023.
